448     def raw_cmd_undo(self, args):
449         if not self.coder.repo:
450             self.io.tool_error("No git repository found.")
451             return
452 
453         last_commit = self.coder.repo.get_head_commit()
454         if not last_commit or not last_commit.parents:
455             self.io.tool_error("This is the first commit in the repository. Cannot undo.")
456             return
457 
458         last_commit_hash = self.coder.repo.get_head_commit_sha(short=True)
459         last_commit_message = self.coder.repo.get_head_commit_message("(unknown)").strip()
460         if last_commit_hash not in self.coder.aider_commit_hashes:
461             self.io.tool_error("The last commit was not made by aider in this chat session.")
462             self.io.tool_output(
463                 "You could try `/git reset --hard HEAD^` but be aware that this is a destructive"
464                 " command!"
465             )
466             return
467 
468         if len(last_commit.parents) > 1:
469             self.io.tool_error(
470                 f"The last commit {last_commit.hexsha} has more than 1 parent, can't undo."
471             )
472             return
473 
474         prev_commit = last_commit.parents[0]
475         changed_files_last_commit = [item.a_path for item in last_commit.diff(prev_commit)]
476 
477         for fname in changed_files_last_commit:
478             if self.coder.repo.repo.is_dirty(path=fname):
479                 self.io.tool_error(
480                     f"The file {fname} has uncommitted changes. Please stash them before undoing."
481                 )
482                 return
483 
484             # Check if the file was in the repo in the previous commit
485             try:
486                 prev_commit.tree[fname]
487             except KeyError:
488                 self.io.tool_error(
489                     f"The file {fname} was not in the repository in the previous commit. Cannot"
490                     " undo safely."
491                 )
492                 return
493 
494         local_head = self.coder.repo.repo.git.rev_parse("HEAD")
495         current_branch = self.coder.repo.repo.active_branch.name
496         try:
497             remote_head = self.coder.repo.repo.git.rev_parse(f"origin/{current_branch}")
498             has_origin = True
499         except ANY_GIT_ERROR:
500             has_origin = False
501 
502         if has_origin:
503             if local_head == remote_head:
504                 self.io.tool_error(
505                     "The last commit has already been pushed to the origin. Undoing is not"
506                     " possible."
507                 )
508                 return
509 
510         # Reset only the files which are part of `last_commit`
511         restored = set()
512         unrestored = set()
513         for file_path in changed_files_last_commit:
514             try:
515                 self.coder.repo.repo.git.checkout("HEAD~1", file_path)
516                 restored.add(file_path)
517             except ANY_GIT_ERROR:
518                 unrestored.add(file_path)
519 
520         if unrestored:
521             self.io.tool_error(f"Error restoring {file_path}, aborting undo.")
522             self.io.tool_output("Restored files:")
523             for file in restored:
524                 self.io.tool_output(f"  {file}")
525             self.io.tool_output("Unable to restore files:")
526             for file in unrestored:
527                 self.io.tool_output(f"  {file}")
528             return
529 
530         # Move the HEAD back before the latest commit
531         self.coder.repo.repo.git.reset("--soft", "HEAD~1")
532 
533         self.io.tool_output(f"Removed: {last_commit_hash} {last_commit_message}")
534 
535         # Get the current HEAD after undo
536         current_head_hash = self.coder.repo.get_head_commit_sha(short=True)

538         self.io.tool_output(f"Now at:  {current_head_hash} {current_head_message}")

592         new_document = Document(after_command, cursor_position=len(after_command))
593 
594         def get_paths():
595             return [self.coder.root] if self.coder.root else None
596 
597         path_completer = PathCompleter(
598             get_paths=get_paths,
599             only_directories=False,
600             expanduser=True,
601         )
602 
603         # Adjust the start_position to replace all of 'after_command'
604         adjusted_start_position = -len(after_command)
605 
606         # Collect all completions
607         all_completions = []
608 
609         # Iterate over the completions and modify them
610         for completion in path_completer.get_completions(new_document, complete_event):
611             quoted_text = self.quote_fname(after_command + completion.text)
612             all_completions.append(
613                 Completion(
614                     text=quoted_text,
615                     start_position=adjusted_start_position,
616                     display=completion.display,
617                     style=completion.style,
618                     selected_style=completion.selected_style,
619                 )
620             )
621 
622         # Add completions from the 'add' command
623         add_completions = self.completions_add()
624         for completion in add_completions:
625             if after_command in completion:
626                 all_completions.append(
627                     Completion(
628                         text=completion,
629                         start_position=adjusted_start_position,
630                         display=completion,
631                     )
632                 )
633 
634         # Sort all completions based on their text
635         sorted_completions = sorted(all_completions, key=lambda c: c.text)
636 
637         # Yield the sorted completions
638         for completion in sorted_completions:
639             yield completion

471             )

474         prev_commit = last_commit.parents[0]
475         changed_files_last_commit = [item.a_path for item in last_commit.diff(prev_commit)]
476 
477         for fname in changed_files_last_commit:

488                 self.io.tool_error(
489                     f"The file {fname} was not in the repository in the previous commit. Cannot"
490                     " undo safely."
491                 )
492                 return

494         local_head = self.coder.repo.repo.git.rev_parse("HEAD")
495         current_branch = self.coder.repo.repo.active_branch.name

515                 self.coder.repo.repo.git.checkout("HEAD~1", file_path)

601         )
602 
603         # Adjust the start_position to replace all of 'after_command'
604         adjusted_start_position = -len(after_command)
605 
606         # Collect all completions
607         all_completions = []
608 
609         # Iterate over the completions and modify them
610         for completion in path_completer.get_completions(new_document, complete_event):
611             quoted_text = self.quote_fname(after_command + completion.text)
612             all_completions.append(
613                 Completion(
614                     text=quoted_text,
615                     start_position=adjusted_start_position,
616                     display=completion.display,
617                     style=completion.style,
618                     selected_style=completion.selected_style,
619                 )
620             )
621 
622         # Add completions from the 'add' command
623         add_completions = self.completions_add()
624         for completion in add_completions:

627                     Completion(
628                         text=completion,
629                         start_position=adjusted_start_position,
630                         display=completion,
631                     )
632                 )

634         # Sort all completions based on their text
635         sorted_completions = sorted(all_completions, key=lambda c: c.text)

637         # Yield the sorted completions
638         for completion in sorted_completions:
